notes.title: Post-Launch Update - Object Visibility
notes.content:
Another small update to help improve the gameplay a bit.

[b][h1]Chalk Visibility[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] With player feedback, the chalk is now more visible for the player, for easier discovery
[/list]

notes.title: Post-Launch Update - Achievements
notes.content:
A small update to the achievement system. More small updates will be sent out over time, if needed.

[h1][b]Achievement Update[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Allows the player to get the "Time's Up, Let's Do This!" achievement without having to use the axe on the hole
[/list]
